additional_controls: Ranged first-roll5/6; source equipment/skill, target action/shield, null drop return and block-release result; raw Player lookup byte.
expected: Eligible Expert-or-Master defense first rolls Counter for nonranged contact.
Counter success invokes playback(true) and suppresses immediate disarm/Recoil even if playback fails.
Otherwise playback(false) precedes actual defensive disarm; Master disarm consumes a second draw only after an eligible target query and source rank/gear gates.
Source drawn is checked after the disarm draw. Missing/undrawn/quest or suppressed Player targets consume no disarm draw.
Nonranged no-Counter always requests Recoil after the disarm helper, independent of its return. Ranged requests it only after successful disarm.
Preserve original stack and callee-saved actor/target registers. No native inventory or rendered acceptance is inferred.
production_subset: NPC/Player blockers and ordinary NPC target drops; partial Player/Creature dispatch, replacement equipment, full original scene/drop and runtime remain separate.
